# montecarlo_oracle_credentials (Data Source)

Oracle credentials are the login Monte Carlo stores for Oracle connections to use. The password is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `db_name` (String) Database to connect to.
- `host` (String) Hostname of the database endpoint.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `port` (Number) Port the database listens on.
- `ssl_ca_data` (String) PEM text of the CA certificate the server's certificate is checked against. Null when none is set.
- `ssl_disabled` (Boolean) Connect without TLS. Null when unset.
- `ssl_skip_cert_verification` (Boolean) Encrypt the connection without checking the server's certificate. Null when unset.
- `ssl_verify_cert` (Boolean) Check the server's certificate against the CA. Null when unset.
- `ssl_verify_identity` (Boolean) Check the certificate and that it names the host. Null when unset.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `user` (String) Database user Monte Carlo logs in as.
